claims_requiring_human_approval.claim: Claim that might be true but needs owner/proof review.
claims_requiring_human_approval.reason: Missing proof, unclear scope, legal/compliance sensitivity, stale source, or marketplace conflict.

forbidden_claims.claim_pattern: Guaranteed performance or compliance claim without proof.
forbidden_claims.reason: Avoid unsupported legal, safety, compliance, or performance promises.

resolution_rule: When sources conflict, prioritize official product pages, official spec sheets, manufacturer certificates, and owner-confirmed notes before marketplace snippets or third-party summaries.
